address.label: Address
address.hint: The socket address to listen for connections on, or systemd{#N} to use the Nth socket passed by systemd socket activation.

mode.label: Mode
mode.hint: The type of socket to use.

decoding.codec.label: Decoding Codec
decoding.codec.hint: The codec to use for decoding events.

tls.enabled.label: TLS Enabled
tls.enabled.hint: Whether or not to require TLS for incoming or outgoing connections. When enabled and used for incoming connections, an identity certificate is also required. See tls.crt_file for more information.

tls.alpn_protocols.label: ALPN protocols
tls.alpn_protocols.hint: Sets the list of supported ALPN protocols. Declare the supported ALPN protocols, which are used during negotiation with peer. They are prioritized in the order that they are defined.

tls.verify_certificate.label: Verify Certificate
tls.verify_certificate.hint: Enables certificate verification. For components that create a server, this requires that the client connections have a valid client certificate. For components that initiate requests, this validates that the upstream has a valid certificate.

tls.verify_hostname.label: Verify Hostname
tls.verify_hostname.hint: Enables hostname verification. If enabled, the hostname used to connect to the remote host must be present in the TLS certificate presented by the remote host, either as the Common Name or as an entry in the Subject Alternative Name extension. Only relevant for outgoing connections.

tls.ca_file.label: Certificate Authority File
tls.ca_file.hint: Absolute path to an additional CA certificate file.

tls.crt_file.label: Certificate File
tls.crt_file.hint: Absolute path to a certificate file used to identify this server.

tls.key_file.label: Private Key
tls.key_file.hint: Absolute path to a private key file used to identify this server.

tls.key_pass.label: Private Key Passphrase
tls.key_pass.hint: Passphrase used to unlock the encrypted key file.

max_length.label: Max Length
max_length.hint: The maximum buffer size of incoming messages.

receive_buffer_bytes.label: Receive Buffer
receive_buffer_bytes.hint: The size of the receive buffer used for each connection. Relevant when: mode = 'tcp' or mode = 'udp'

permit_origin.label: Permit Origin
permit_origin.hint: List of allowed origin IP networks. IP addresses must be in CIDR notation.

decoding.avro.strip_schema_id_prefix.label: Strip Avro Schema ID Prefix
decoding.avro.strip_schema_id_prefix.hint: For Avro datum encoded in Kafka messages, the bytes are prefixed with the schema ID.

decoding.gelf.lossy.label: Decoding Gelf Lossy
decoding.gelf.lossy.hint: Determines whether or not to replace invalid UTF-8 sequences instead of failing.

decoding.influxdb.lossy.label: Decoding Influxdb Lossy
decoding.influxdb.lossy.hint: Determines whether or not to replace invalid UTF-8 sequences instead of failing.

decoding.json.lossy.label: Decoding Json Lossy
decoding.json.lossy.hint: Determines whether or not to replace invalid UTF-8 sequences instead of failing.

decoding.native_json.lossy.label: Decoding Native Json Lossy
decoding.native_json.lossy.hint: Determines whether or not to replace invalid UTF-8 sequences instead of failing.

decoding.syslog.lossy.label: Decoding Syslog Lossy
decoding.syslog.lossy.hint: Determines whether or not to replace invalid UTF-8 sequences instead of failing.

decoding.vrl.source.label: Decoding Vrl Source
decoding.vrl.source.hint: The Vector Remap Language (VRL) program to execute for each event. Note that the final contents of the . target will be used as the decoding result. Compilation error or use of ‘abort’ in a program will result in a decoding error.

decoding.vrl.timezone.label: Decoding Vrl Timezone
decoding.vrl.timezone.hint: The name of the timezone to apply to timestamp conversions that do not contain an explicit time zone. The time zone name may be any name in the TZ database, or local to indicate system local time.
